name: Bay
engine_detail: Chromium 154 (CEF 8037, ungoogled patches) with WebKit for streaming sites

name: ilo
engine_detail: Chromium 157 (ungoogled-chromium), with WebKit for protected video on Mac

name: OpenArch
engine_detail: Chromium 158 (Chrome's own framework, CEF dropped in 0.4.0), WebKit for DRM streaming

name: Oriel
notes: An unofficial port of Search, the Mac browser by Office Commun, made by Char Studio for Windows 10 and 11 on x64 and ARM64. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Office Commun. Also offered in the Microsoft Store. Official pages do not mention iOS.

name: Wren
engine_detail: Chromium 158 (Wren Runtime 0.6.1, a native wrapper, not Electron)
notes: Formerly Flow. MultiboxLabs rebuilt Flow and renamed it Wren, first released 14 November 2026.
